mapper.insert: INSERT INTO definition_publication (tenant_id, definition_id, process_key, definition_version, published_by, authorized_role, published_at, change_note, validation_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, #{processKey}, #{definitionVersion}, #{publishedBy}, #{authorizedRole}, #{publishedAt}, #{changeNote}, #{validationJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM definition_publication WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND definition_id=#{definitionId}
